meta_title: VPN Reseller Program: Start Your Own VPN Business | VpnHood!
meta_description: Four ways to resell VpnHood!: bulk access codes, an automated store of your own, a white-label VPN brand, or affiliate commission. No servers to run.
page_desc: Sell a VPN that keeps working where others get blocked. The engine is open source, the apps are free to download, and you never run a server: what you buy and resell is an access code.
hero_alt: A glowing key at the centre of four dotted paths, leading out to a code card, a shop, an app and a link
intro_title: Build a high-margin VPN business in censored markets
intro_p1: Launching a VPN service normally means renting servers, writing apps for four platforms and keeping all of it alive. With VpnHood! you skip every one of those. The engine is fully open source, VpnHood! CONNECT is already published on Google Play, the App Store, Windows and Linux, and the protocol is built to get past deep packet inspection.
intro_p2: What you sell is an access code. We run the servers and ship the apps; you set your prices, own your customers and keep the margin. It is a product that does not look like every other commercial VPN: transparent enough for a customer to audit, and effective where censorship is heaviest.
routes_title: Pick the way you want to sell
routes_desc: They differ in how much you automate and how much of the brand is yours. You can start at the top and move down later; the access codes are the same either way.
route_codes_best: Best for shops, forums and sellers with no billing system.
route_codes_desc: Buy a batch of access codes at reseller pricing and hand them out however you already sell: a message, an invoice, a card in a shop. Nothing to install, and no integration work.
route_codes_runs: Nothing. You receive the codes as a file.
route_codes_bills: You do, in whatever way you already do it.
route_codes_brand: Yours in the sale, ours in the app.
route_store_best: Best for resellers who want orders handled while they sleep.
route_store_desc: Install VpnHood! PARTNER in your own WHMCS. Your customer orders on your site, your store gets the access code from us out of your prepaid credit and hands it over, and renewals, suspensions and cancellations follow on their own.
route_store_runs: Your own WHMCS, with VpnHood! PARTNER installed.
route_store_bills: You do, through your own store and gateways.
route_store_brand: Yours, on everything the customer sees.
route_brand_best: Best for partners building a product, not a side income.
route_brand_desc: Everything above, plus your own app with your name and icon on Google Play and the App Store, and in-app purchases that land as orders in your store. We build all of it and stay invisible behind it.
route_brand_runs: Your store, your app builds, your store accounts.
route_brand_bills: You do, on the web and in the app stores.
route_affiliate_best: Best for creators and communities with an audience.
route_affiliate_desc: Do not sell anything at all. Share your link, and earn commission when someone buys from us through it. No credit to hold, no support to answer.
selling_title: What your customer is paying for
selling_desc: The apps are free to download and the source is public. What your customer pays for is the access code that turns on the premium network, and these are the reasons they pay for it rather than settle for a cheaper name.
why_cross_platform_desc: VpnHood! CONNECT is free to download on Android, iOS, Windows and Linux, so you can serve a wide audience from day one with no development work.
why_open_source_desc: VpnHood! CONNECT, the server and the VpnHood! ENGINE behind them are on GitHub under the LGPL, and Include Security has audited them for the Open Technology Fund's Red Team Lab. Your customer can read the code instead of taking your word for it, and no licence fee sits between you and your margin.
why_undetectable_desc: Cloak Mode is designed to make VPN traffic resemble ordinary HTTPS browsing, so deep packet inspection has no signature to match. In markets where ordinary VPNs stop working, that is why customers stay subscribed.
why_global_desc: A premium access code reaches servers in more than [count] countries across five continents, and the list grows without you having to do anything about it.
get_pricing_desc: You buy access codes below retail and set your own price. The rate is agreed with you, based on volume, and is paid from a prepaid balance you top up.
get_module_desc: The WHMCS module that automates the whole sale is open source and costs nothing. Install it, sign in, and it runs; there is no licence fee and no per-seat charge.
get_products_desc: The plans you are allowed to sell appear in your store on their own, with their billing cycles already set.
get_support_desc: You deal with the team that builds the thing. When something breaks in a censored market at midnight, that is the difference that matters.
start_contact_title: Tell us what you want to sell
start_contact_desc: Write to reseller@vpnhood.com with the market you sell into and the volume you expect. We will come back with pricing and the credentials for whichever route you pick.
start_selling_desc: Top up your balance, take your first order, and deliver the code. From there it is your business: your prices, your customers, your brand.
cta: Ready to sell a VPN that works where the others have stopped?
